description: This PHP class 'ViewLocationController' extends 'BaseAdminController' and manages the administrative functionality for location views in the OrangeHRM system. It prepares Vue.js components with country data and sets access permissions.

classes.name: ViewLocationController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling location view rendering and permissions in the OrangeHRM admin panel.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with a list of countries and sets necessary permissions before rendering.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data groups for capability validation, specifically for 'locations'.
